art_direction: 浅蓝霭底鼠尾草双眼，左眼较浅，同向右望。
composition_variation: Set a clear diagonal relationship with the left eye three percent lower, its bowl about twenty percent shallower. Keep the right upper lid a gently rounded arc rather than a heavy bar. Large black pupils touch both lids and turn slightly right together. Use identical sage bands at the lower and outer edges, and one thin long ivory glint inside each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
